label: Bumping with a growing increment
subgoals: Start every activity at 0 and the increment at 1
Add the current increment to each variable of each learned clause
Divide the increment by the decay factor after each conflict

label: Picking the next decision
subgoals: Drop the variables that are already assigned
Compare the activities of the remaining variables
Pick the variable with the highest activity

label: Explicit decay gives the same ranking
section: Explicit decay gives the same ranking
subgoals: Multiply every activity by the decay factor on each conflict
Add 1 to each variable of the learned clause
Compare with the growing-increment scores scaled by the decay factor to the power k - 1
